text:
tara.h: Quick question  we approved a promo for someone in Ireland effective Feb 1 but the signed packet hit at 7:10pm after payroll cutoff. Do we do an off-cycle or include retro on next run?
people-ops: Short answer: include on next scheduled run unless backdate > 90 days or vendor asks for ad-hoc. For Ireland, confirm PPS and any tax status changes.
tara.h: Manager says no tax status change, just band bump and salary increase. Pack is signed by manager only; need manager's manager sign-off too?
people-ops: Yes please. Lattice evidence must include manager + manager's manager approvals for payroll to accept retro. If you don't have mm signoff, ask manager to add a timestamped approval comment in Lattice.
comp-ops: Heads up  if the promo changes equity target or refresh schedule loop comp-ops before payroll. Equity adjustments often require separate award paperwork and can delay processing.
tara.h: Got it. If I email payroll@ with packet + Lattice link and PPS, will they queue it for next run? What subject should I use so it doesn't get missed?
payroll-bot: payroll-bot: Payroll intake cutoff is 24h before run. Use subject: "Retro Request: [Last, First] - [Country]" and add "BACKDATE" if effective >30 days ago. Attach signed packet & Lattice URL.
tara.h: Thanks  I'll get mm signoff in Lattice now and email payroll with subject "Retro Request: Byrne, Seamus - Ireland"
